   - The first 6 terms are: `[22, 1, 2, 22, 2, 1]`.

### **Formal Recurrence Relation**

Based on the above observations, we can define the recurrence relation as follows:

$$
a(n) = 
\begin{cases}

1, & \text{if } n = 1 \\
2, & \text{if } n = 2 \\
22, & \text{if } n = 3 \\

1, & \text{if } n = 5 \\
44, & \text{if } n \geq 6 \text{ and } n \mod 6 = 0 \\
a(n - 6), & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$

- The base cases (`n = 0` to `n = 5`) define the initial 6-term block.
- For `n ≥ 6`, the value is determined by:
